hb260928enr-impact.note: Filled from Confluence https://expoplatform.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/P2/pages/2112389133/Required+Custom+Category+Filters; EP-56915 comments 2026-09-22 by Konstantin Shein and 2026-09-23 by Vladyslav Dziubenko
hb260928enr-impact.to: Organisers get at least one category from every required filter on user and exhibitor records. It covers seven Add category popups: user and exhibitor profile activity/interest categories, products, brands, exhibitor events, news and groups. The admin Categories page gains an Optional/Required filter type and some layout clean-up. The backend will not enforce the rule, so categories set through the admin panel, import, the API or the mobile app are not checked.

hb260928enr-notes.note: Filled from EP-56915 comments 2026-09-28 by Konstantin Shein and Shubham Goswami, 2026-09-23 by Vladyslav Dziubenko, 2026-09-22 by Konstantin Shein; jiraColumns.due
hb260928enr-notes.to: 28 Sep: brief sent to the client; build waits for the client's final approval. 23 Sep: QA raised 13 open spec questions and estimated about 5 + 2 days (web only; mobile needs a separate task). 22 Sep: FE about 4d, BE about 3-4d. Jira due 13 Oct.

hb260928enr-rationale.note: Filled from Confluence https://expoplatform.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/P2/pages/2112389133/Required+Custom+Category+Filters; EP-56915 comment 2026-09-11 by Ajay Singh
hb260928enr-rationale.to: Organisers want to mark custom category filters as required, so users and exhibitors must choose at least one category from each such filter when setting activity, interest or product categories. It is a paid client request, so the brief is being confirmed with the client before the build starts. The rule also applies to categories saved earlier, and the category limit is raised automatically when there are more required filters than the limit allows, so users cannot reach a dead end.

hb260928enr-why.note: Filled from EP-56915 comment 2026-09-11 by Ajay Singh; Confluence https://expoplatform.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/P2/pages/2112389133/Required+Custom+Category+Filters
hb260928enr-why.to: Paid Vinexposium request: let organisers mark custom category filters as required, so users and exhibitors must pick at least one.
